import ctypes
import os

# Load the libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the gsl_sf_mathieu_workspace structure
class gsl_sf_mathieu_workspace(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [
        ('size', ctypes.c_size_t),
        ('even_order', ctypes.c_uint),
        ('odd_order', ctypes.c_uint),
        ('extra_values', ctypes.c_uint),
        ('aa', ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)),
        ('bb', ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)),
        ('dd', ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)),
        ('ee', ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)),
        ('tt', ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)),
        ('e2', ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)),
        ('zz', ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)),
        ('eval', ctypes.c_void_p),
        ('evec', ctypes.c_void_p),
        ('wmat', ctypes.c_void_p)
    ]

# Define the function prototypes
alloc_func = gsl.gsl_sf_mathieu_alloc
alloc_func.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_double]
alloc_func.restype = ctypes.POINTER(gsl_sf_mathieu_workspace)

free_func = gsl.gsl_sf_mathieu_free
free_func.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_sf_mathieu_workspace)]
free_func.restype = None

# Function to allocate workspace
def allocate_mathieu_workspace(nn, qq):
    workspace = alloc_func(nn, qq)
    if not workspace:
        raise MemoryError('Failed to allocate gsl_sf_mathieu_workspace')
    return workspace

# Function to free workspace
def free_mathieu_workspace(workspace):
    if workspace:
        free_func(workspace)

def assert_test():
    try:
        # Test allocation and freeing of workspace
        nn = 10
        qq = 5.0
        workspace = allocate_mathieu_workspace(nn, qq)
        assert workspace.contents.size == nn, 'Size mismatch'
        assert workspace.contents.even_order > nn/2, 'Even order calculation error'
        assert workspace.contents.odd_order > (nn + 1)/2, 'Odd order calculation error'
        free_mathieu_workspace(workspace)
